# Filmfare Awards Punjabi

}}
Filmfare Awards Punjabi are presented to the best films, performers and artists that work in Punjabi cinema. The event was first held in 2017.
History
The first awards ceremony was held on 31 March 2017 in Mohali. It became the second film award for Punjabi films after PTC Punjabi Film Awards, which was introduced in 2011.
Jitesh Pillai said, “It is a moment of utmost pride, as we witness Filmfare Awards expand its footprints across the nation. We, at Filmfare, have always rewarded creativity and diligence of the films across industries and promote more such wonderful cinematic experiences. The 1st Edition of Filmfare Awards Punjabi 2017 will be a night of grandeur and elegance and we are looking forward to meet and greet the whole of Punjabi film industry.”
